title: calendula incana subsp. maritima
intro: Calendula incana subsp. maritima, commonly known as a coastal variety of the pot marigold, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Calendula genus. This plant has been used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Calendula incana subsp. maritima include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and skin-soothing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and carotenoids, such as lutein, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
